name: Documentation Agent
description: Automatically generates and maintains documentation for agents, workflows, and blocks. Creates usage guides, API references, and changelog entries.

inputs.name: targetId
inputs.description: ID of the agent/block/workflow to document

inputs.name: documentType
inputs.description: Type of document to generate: readme, api-reference, usage-guide, changelog, tutorial

outputs.name: warnings
outputs.description: Warnings about missing information or potential issues

prompts.tutorialPrompt:
Create a step-by-step tutorial for using:

Name: {name}
Description: {description}

Capabilities:
{capabilities}

Example Use Cases:
{useCases}

The tutorial should:
1. Start with prerequisites
2. Walk through basic usage
3. Show intermediate examples
4. Cover advanced scenarios
5. Include troubleshooting tips

Make it beginner-friendly but comprehensive.
